summary: DigitalBridge Group, Inc. filed an 8-K to report that its indirect subsidiaries issued $400M aggregate principal amount of Series 2026-1 Secured Fund Fee Revenue Notes in a private placement. The notes consist of up to $100M variable funding notes and $300M of 6.326% fixed-rate notes, secured by investment management fees and equity interests. This is a routine debt financing transaction rather than a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, or other change-of-control event is disclosed.
